# Data product idea

**Working name:** Product Holdings

## 1. What problem are we trying to solve?

Our customer service and relationship teams cannot easily see which banking products a customer already holds. Information is spread across separate account, card and loan systems, and teams spend time checking each one. We want to give them a consistent view so they can respond to customers faster and avoid discussing products the customer already has.

## 2. Who needs this, and what will they do with it?

Customer service agents need the information when a customer contacts the bank. For example, an agent should be able to check whether the customer has an active credit card before discussing a card-related request.

Relationship managers also need an overview before a customer meeting. They want to understand the customer's current products and prepare relevant questions.

## 3. What information do they need?

For each customer, we need to know which accounts, cards and loans they hold. For each product, the teams need to see the product type, whether it is active or closed, and when it was opened or closed, if available.

The teams also need to know when the information was last refreshed and which system it came from. The view should make it possible to answer questions such as: “Does this customer already have a credit card?” and “Which products have been closed recently?”

The meaning of “recently” still needs to be agreed.

## 4. What would a useful result look like?

An agent can look up a customer and see their products together in one place, without checking three systems separately. A relationship manager can use the same information to prepare for a meeting.

We would know the result is useful if teams spend less time checking products across systems and report fewer cases where they recommend a product the customer already holds. We have not yet agreed on numerical targets.

## If you know

### Where might the information come from?

The account management system, card management system and loan system hold the relevant information. A customer master system may help connect the records. The exact systems, fields and matching rules need to be confirmed with the data teams.

### How current or reliable does it need to be?

The teams would like a refreshed view each business day before the start of customer service. They also need to know if information is delayed or missing. The publication time, acceptable delay and quality measures still need to be agreed.

### Are there sensitive uses, restrictions or things to exclude?

The information relates to identifiable customers. Access should be limited to staff who need it for their work and follow the bank's existing access rules. The product should not include account balances or transaction details in its first version. The data protection team needs to confirm the permitted uses.

### Who can help answer questions about this idea?

The customer service product owner can clarify the users' needs. Representatives from the account, card, loan and customer master data teams can help identify sources. The data protection team can advise on access and permitted use. Named contacts are not yet assigned.
